title: FrameflowOperations
description: Changes to a project the creator already has, as opposed to a first cut's full plan. Every operation addresses a span of the recording in source seconds, read from the transcript; code works out which clips that trims, splits, deletes or extends, so no operation ever names a clip.

summary.description: One or two sentences for the creator: what these operations do to their cut and why - or, with no operations, why nothing could or should change.

action.description: remove: take this span of the recording out of the cut. restore: put this span of the recording back into the cut, in recording order.

source.description: File name of the recording the span comes from. Optional when the main track uses a single recording.

confidence.description: Optional; absent means high. "low" when you are not sure this is what the creator meant.

override_human_edit.description: Set ONLY when the instruction explicitly asks to undo something the creator changed in the editor since Frameflow last wrote - restoring material they removed, or removing material they put back. Quote or paraphrase the part of the instruction that asks for it. Without this, such an operation is rejected: the creator's own edits win.

graphics.description: Optional. Graphics to add over the cut - a title, a caption, a lower third, a product card - each rendered by HyperFrames with a transparent background onto its own Graphics track. Applied after the operations. Each is anchored to a moment in the recording, so it appears when that is said.

text.description: The words on a text card. Required unless composition is given.

kind.description: Optional: draw the text card as a product card (text is the product's name, with a subtitle and a price) or a lower third (text is a person's name, with their role or handle as the subtitle), in the brand kit's style at the left, just above the captions. A plain text card when absent.

subtitle.description: Optional, with kind: the line under the text.

price.description: Optional, product cards only: the price as it should read, shown as a tag.

composition.description: Optional: path to a HyperFrames project folder you wrote (its index.html, transparent background, the project's width and height), for anything a text card cannot do. Rendered as it is.

source.description: File name of the recording `at` refers to. Optional when the main track uses a single recording.

at.description: Seconds into the recording where the graphic appears; it must be in the cut.

broll.description: Optional. The creator's own images or clips cutting away from the recording while it keeps playing underneath, where what is said matches what they show. Each goes on a B-roll track above the cut, filling the frame, its own sound turned right down. Applied after the operations. Each is anchored to a moment in the recording, so it comes in when that is said, and later edits move it with the cut.

path.description: The full path of one of the creator's images or video clips.

start.description: Optional, clips only: seconds into the clip to start from; 0 when absent.

source.description: File name of the recording `at` refers to. Optional when the main track uses a single recording.

at.description: Seconds into the recording where it comes in; it must be in the cut.

duration.description: Seconds on screen. It stops at the end of the video.
